data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_Body
data.value: Parlotype tibdel id-diskors f'test kullimkien fuq il-kompjuter tiegħek: iddetta f'kwalunkwe app, u t-test rikonoxxut jiġi ttajpjat eżatt fejn ikun il-kursur tiegħek. B'mod prestabbilit, ir-rikonoxximent isir kollu kemm hu fuq dan il-kompjuter — l-awdjo tiegħek qatt ma joħroġ minn hawn sakemm ma taqlibx apposta għal magna bbażata fuq is-sħaba.

data.name: Onboarding_Recording_Body
data.value: Agħfas waħda mill-hotkeys tad-dettatura tiegħek, jew ikklikkja l-buttuna tar-reġistrazzjoni mmarkata fuq il-widget. Meta tispiċċa titkellem, it-test rikonoxxut jiġi ttajpjat fl-app li kont qed tuża l-aħħar. Il-hotkeys tiegħek:

data.name: Onboarding_Recording_EscLine
data.value: Esc — ikkanċella r-reġistrazzjoni attwali mingħajr ma tittajpja xejn

data.name: Onboarding_Hotkeys_None
data.value: L-ebda hotkey tad-dettatura mhix issettjata — uża l-buttuna tar-reġistrazzjoni fuq il-widget, jew żid hotkey fis-Settings → Hotkeys.

data.name: Onboarding_Widget_Body
data.value: Din il-window żgħira li dejjem tibqa' fuq nett hija l-kontroll tad-dettatura tiegħek. Il-buttuna l-kbira tibda u twaqqaf ir-reġistrazzjoni; għaddi l-kursur fuq il-kard biex tara l-istatus attwali. Iġbed il-parti ta' fuq biex tiċaqlaqha kullimkien, u l-buttuna ✕ taħbiha fit-tray. Il-magni li joffru għażla tal-lingwa juru strixxa tal-lingwa tul in-naħa t'isfel.

data.name: Onboarding_Engine_Body
data.value: Parlotype tiġi b'diversi magni tar-rikonoxximent — aqleb bejniethom fil-lista mmarkata. Parakeet v3 hija dik prestabbilita: veloċi, kompletament fuq l-apparat, u tidentifika awtomatikament 25 lingwa Ewropea. Kull magna żżid il-paġni tagħha stess man-navigazzjoni fuq ix-xellug.

data.name: Onboarding_Model_Body
data.value: Kull magna lokali toffri mudelli ta' daqsijiet differenti — mudelli akbar huma aktar preċiżi iżda aktar bil-mod u jeħdu aktar spazju fuq id-disk. Il-fajls tal-mudelli jitniżżlu awtomatikament l-ewwel darba li jintużaw; il-mudelli li diġà jinsabu fuq id-disk huma mmarkati fil-lista.

data.name: Onboarding_Cloud_Title
data.value: Il-Magni bbażati fuq is-Sħaba huma Fakultattivi

data.name: Onboarding_Cloud_Body
data.value: Iż-żewġ magni bbażati fuq is-sħaba huma mitfija b'mod prestabbilit u jeħtieġu ċ-ċavetta tal-API tiegħek stess. Waqt li waħda tkun attiva, l-awdjo tiegħek jintbagħat lil dak il-fornitur għat-traskrizzjoni u l-widget juri l-badge “Sħaba” b'mod permanenti. Kull ħaġa oħra f'Parlotype tibqa' kompletament lokali.

data.name: Onboarding_Tray_Body
data.value: Meta taħbi jew tagħlaq il-widget, Parlotype ma toħroġx — tibqa' tisma' għall-hotkeys tiegħek mit-tray tas-sistema. Ikklikkja l-ikona tat-tray biex terġa' ġġib lura l-widget. Biex toħroġ għal kollox, ikklikkja bil-lemin fuq l-ikona tat-tray u agħżel Oħroġ. Biex il-hotkey tiegħek jaħdem mill-mument li tidħol, Parlotype tibda ma' Windows u tistenna fit-tray — l-ebda window ma tinfetaħ. Itfi dan meta trid fis-Settings → Applikazzjoni → Tnedija.

data.name: Onboarding_Recap_Body
data.value: Iddetta kullimkien bil-hotkeys tiegħek jew bil-buttuna tal-widget. Il-magni, il-mudelli, il-hotkeys u l-lingwi jinsabu fis-Settings — u din il-gwida, flimkien ma' referenza tal-hotkeys, dejjem tinsab taħt Settings → Għajnuna.

data.name: Help_Intro
data.value: Ġdid għal Parlotype? Il-gwida bil-pass tgħaddi mir-reġistrazzjoni, il-widget, il-magni u l-mudelli — tiftaħ kull skrin u tmarka l-kontrolli hija u sejra.

data.name: Help_NoHotkeys
data.value: L-ebda hotkey tad-dettatura mhix ikkonfigurata. Żid waħda fit-taqsima tal-Hotkeys.

data.name: Settings_Theme_Description
data.value: Agħżel bejn dehra tas-sistema, ċara, jew skura.

data.name: Settings_InterfaceLanguage_Description
data.value: Il-lingwa li biha huma miktuba l-windows ta' Parlotype stess. Ma għandha l-ebda effett fuq b'liema lingwi tista' tiddetta — dawk jiġu ssettjati taħt Lingwa.

data.name: Settings_InterfaceLanguage_SystemDetailFormat
data.comment: {0} is the language name in its own language, e.g. "Русский".

data.name: Settings_InterfaceLanguage_SystemDetailUnsupported
data.value: Isegwi lil Windows — għadha mhix tradotta, għalhekk jintuża l-Ingliż

data.name: Settings_SilenceTimeout_WaitFormat
data.comment: {0} is the wait-time name, {1} the duration in seconds. Keep the "s" unit next to {1}.

data.name: Transcribe_CloudBadge
data.comment: Short badge on the widget while a cloud engine is active. Keep it very short.

data.name: Transcribe_OpenSettingsLink
data.comment: Link on the widget's language strip. Keep the trailing arrow.

data.name: Transcribe_Status_RuntimeRestartRequiredFormat
data.comment: {0} is a runtime name such as "Vulkan" or "Cpu" — never translated.
data.value: Irrestartja lil Parlotype biex tuża r-runtime {0}

data.name: Transcribe_Status_RuntimeUnavailableFormat
data.comment: {0} is a runtime name such as "Vulkan" or "Cpu" — never translated.

data.name: Transcribe_Status_CloudKeyRejected
data.value: Iċ-Ċavetta tal-API tas-Sħaba Miċħuda — iċċekkja s-Settings

data.name: Transcribe_Status_CloudQuotaExceeded
data.value: Kwota tas-Sħaba Maqbuża — iċċekkja l-pjan u l-fatturazzjoni

data.name: Transcribe_Status_CloudRateLimited
data.value: Limitu tar-Rata tas-Sħaba Milħuq — erġa' pprova dalwaqt

data.name: Transcribe_Status_CloudProviderUnavailable
data.value: Fornitur tas-Sħaba Mhux Disponibbli — erġa' pprova dalwaqt

data.comment: Badge naming the active cloud provider. "OpenAI" is a product name — do not translate it.

data.name: Transcribe_CloudProvider_XaiGrok
data.comment: Badge naming the active cloud provider. "xAI Grok" is a product name — do not translate it.

data.name: Transcribe_Source_Auto
data.comment: Source-language chip when the engine detects the language itself. Keep it short — it sits in a narrow chip.

data.name: ModelDownload_ConfirmFormat
data.comment: {0} is the model name, {1} its download size (e.g. "1.5 GB").

data.name: ModelDownload_ConfirmWithProjectorFormat
data.comment: {0} is the model name, {1} its download size. Used for Gemma 4 models that bundle a vision projector.

data.name: Settings_WhisperModel_Title
data.comment: "Whisper" is the engine's product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_WhisperRuntime_Title
data.comment: "Whisper" is the engine's product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_WhisperOutput_Title
data.comment: "Whisper" is the engine's product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_Gemma4Model_Title
data.comment: "Gemma 4" is a model family name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_ParakeetModel_Title
data.comment: "Parakeet" is a model family name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_LlamaCppServer_Title
data.comment: "llama.cpp" is a project name — never translated, and keep the lower case.

data.name: Settings_SilenceTimeout_Description
data.value: Kemm iddum tistenna wara li jispiċċa d-diskors qabel it-traskrizzjoni.

data.name: Settings_SilenceTimeout_HoldNote
data.value: Tapplika meta tqabbad u titfi d-dettatura b'toggle. Il-mod taż-żamma jinjora dan — iż-żamma tat-tast diġà tgħid meta tkun lest, għalhekk iż-żamma kollha tiġi ttraskritta f'daqqa.

data.name: Settings_Startup_Description
data.value: Parlotype tisma' għall-hotkey tad-dettatura tiegħek mit-tray tas-sistema, għalhekk trid tkun qed taħdem qabel ma tkun tista' tiddetta.

data.name: Settings_Startup_BlockedBody
data.comment: "Startup apps" and "Enable" name real Windows UI — use the wording Windows itself uses in this language.
data.value: Iftaħ it-Task Manager, mur fuq it-tab Startup apps, agħżel Parlotype u agħżel Enable. Windows iżomm din id-deċiżjoni separata minn dan is-setting, u t-Task Manager biss jista' jġibha lura.

data.name: Settings_Startup_WhatChangesBody
data.comment: "HKCU Run" is a registry path — never translated.
data.value: Entrata waħda taħt il-kont tal-utent tiegħek stess (HKCU Run), li tindika lejn Parlotype. L-ebda servizz, l-ebda xogħol skedat, l-ebda dritt ta' amministratur, xejn fil-livell tal-magna kollha. Tista' taraha u tneħħiha int stess fit-Task Manager → Startup apps.

data.name: Settings_Startup_State_NotInstalled
data.comment: "Setup.exe" is a file name — never translated.
data.value: Din il-verżjoni ma tistax tibda waħedha mad-dħul — ma ġietx installata minn Setup.exe.

data.name: Settings_Startup_State_BlockedByWindows
data.value: Windows għandha Parlotype mitfija fit-Task Manager → Startup apps. Erġa' qabbadha hemm biex dan is-setting jibda jaħdem.

data.name: Settings_Startup_State_Enabled
data.value: Parlotype tibda ma' Windows u tistenna fit-tray — l-ebda window ma tinfetaħ.

data.name: Settings_Startup_State_Disabled
data.value: Parlotype taħdem biss meta tibdiha int stess.

data.name: Settings_Updates_Description
data.value: Parlotype tista' tiċċekkja GitHub għal ħarġiet ġodda, tniżżilhom fl-isfond, u tinstallahom meta toħroġ.

data.name: Settings_Updates_CadenceNote
data.value: Meta mqabbad, Parlotype tiċċekkja ftit wara t-tnedija u kull 6 sigħat wara dan.

data.name: Settings_Updates_WhatSendsBody
data.comment: "api.github.com" is a host name — never translated.
data.value: Talba anonima lil api.github.com għal-lista pubblika tal-ħarġiet ta' Parlotype, u t-tniżżil tal-fajl tal-ħarġa nnifisha. L-ebda kont, l-ebda identifikatur tal-magna, l-ebda data dwar l-użu. Din hija l-unika talba tan-network li tagħmel Parlotype sakemm il-magni tad-diskors tiegħek kollha jkunu lokali.

data.name: Settings_Updates_Status_NotInstalled
data.comment: "Setup.exe" is a file name — never translated.
data.value: Din il-verżjoni ma tistax taġġorna lilha nnifisha — ma ġietx installata minn Setup.exe.

data.name: Settings_Updates_Status_AvailableFormat
data.comment: {0} is a version number such as "0.4.4".

data.name: Settings_Updates_Status_DownloadingFormat
data.comment: {0} is a version number such as "0.4.4".

data.name: Settings_Updates_Status_ReadyFormat
data.comment: {0} is a version number. The update is staged, not installed — it applies as Parlotype closes.
data.value: Il-verżjoni {0} ġiet imniżżla. Tiġi installata meta toħroġ minn Parlotype.

data.name: Settings_Updates_Never
data.comment: Shown where a date would go, when no update check has ever run.

data.name: Settings_Updates_DevelopmentBuild
data.comment: Shown where a version number would go, for a build that was not installed.

data.name: Settings_Data_Description
data.value: Fejn Parlotype iżżomm il-mudelli, is-settings u ċ-ċwievet tal-API tiegħek.

data.name: Settings_Data_UninstallToggleOn
data.value: Ħassar Kollox Meta Niddiżinstalla lil Parlotype

data.name: Settings_Data_UninstallToggleOff
data.value: Żomm id-Data Tiegħi Meta Niddiżinstalla lil Parlotype

data.name: Settings_Data_UninstallNote
data.value: Mitfi b'mod prestabbilit, biex jekk terġa' tinstalla Parlotype ma tispiċċax tniżżel diversi gigabytes mill-ġdid. Meta mqabbad, id-diżinstallazzjoni tneħħi wkoll il-mudelli mniżżla, is-settings u ċ-ċwievet tal-API mħżuna tiegħek.

data.name: Settings_Data_SaveFailed_Keep
data.value: Ma setgħetx tissejvja dik il-preferenza. Id-diżinstallazzjoni xorta se żżomm id-data tiegħek.

data.name: Settings_Data_SaveFailed_Delete
data.value: Ma setgħetx tissejvja dik il-preferenza — id-diżinstallazzjoni xorta se tħassar il-mudelli mniżżla, is-settings u ċ-ċwievet tal-API tiegħek. Jekk jogħġbok erġa' pprova.

data.name: Settings_Data_DeleteDialog_BodyFormat
data.comment: {0} is a size such as "1.5 GB", {1} the models folder path. Keep the blank line between the two paragraphs.
data.value:
Dan ineħħi {0} minn {1}.
Is-settings u ċ-ċwievet tal-API tiegħek jinżammu. Il-mudelli jerġgħu jitniżżlu awtomatikament id-darba li jmiss li tiddetta.

data.name: Settings_Data_DeleteFailed
data.value: Ma setax jitħassar kull fajl — xi ħaġa għadha qed tużah. Irrestartja lil Parlotype u erġa' pprova.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Description
data.comment: "Whisper.net" is a library name — never translated.
data.value: Agħżel liema backend ta' Whisper.net iġib il-mudell tad-diskors. Il-bidliet jibdew jaħdmu wara restart.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_RestartNoteFormat
data.comment: {0} is the runtime already loaded, {1} the one just chosen — both names like "Vulkan" or "CPU", never translated.
data.value: Din is-sessjoni diġà qed tuża r-runtime {0}. Whisper jagħżel ir-runtime tiegħu darba għal kull tnedija, għalhekk irrestartja lil Parlotype biex taqleb għar-runtime {1} — sa dak iż-żmien, ir-reġistrazzjoni ma tibdiex.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_VulkanMissing
data.comment: "vulkan-1.dll" is a file name — never translated.
data.value: Il-loader ta' Vulkan (vulkan-1.dll) ma nstabx f'din is-sistema.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_DownloadVulkanSdkButton
data.comment: Keep the trailing arrow — it marks a link that leaves the app.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Auto_Description
data.value: Ipprova Vulkan, imbagħad aqa' lura fuq CPU. Rakkomandat.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Vulkan_Name
data.comment: A product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Vulkan_Description
data.value: Kwalunkwe GPU permezz ta' Vulkan (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA). Jeħtieġ drivers tal-GPU b'appoġġ għal Vulkan.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Cpu_Name
data.comment: Kept as "CPU" in every language — it is the term users see in system tools.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Cpu_Description
data.value: Sfurza inferenza bis-CPU biss. Dejjem taħdem iżda aktar bil-mod għal mudelli akbar.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_VulkanUnavailableReason
data.comment: "vulkan-1.dll" is a file name — never translated.
data.value: Il-loader ta' Vulkan (vulkan-1.dll) ma nstabx. Installa d-drivers tal-GPU jew il-Vulkan SDK.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Description
data.comment: "Esc" is a key name — use whatever that key is called on a keyboard in this language, usually "Esc".
data.value: Żomm tast biex titkellem, jew agħfas darbtejn biex tiddetta mingħajr idejk. Agħfas Esc waqt ir-reġistrazzjoni biex twarrabha.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_None
data.value: L-ebda hotkey mhix ikkonfigurata — id-dettatura tista' tinbeda biss mill-widget.

data.name: Settings_Model_Installed
data.comment: Badge on a model that is already on disk. Shared by the Gemma 4 and Parakeet lists.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Heading
data.comment: Page heading. The shorter navigation label is Settings_Engine_Title.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Description
data.value: Agħżel liema magna tagħmel it-traskrizzjoni tad-diskors tiegħek. Il-bidliet jibdew jaħdmu fir-reġistrazzjoni li jmiss.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Gemma4SectionLabel
data.comment: "Gemma 4" is a model family name — never translated. Only "(Experimental)" is prose.

data.name: Settings_Engine_PreloadNote
data.value: Meta mqabbad, il-mudell tad-diskors jillowdja fl-isfond mat-tnedija tal-app biex l-ewwel reġistrazzjoni tiegħek tibda minnufih. Juża memorja żejda waqt li tkun għaddejja fl-istennija. Jibda jaħdem mat-tnedija li jmiss.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Parakeet_Name
data.comment: "Parakeet v3" is a model name — never translated. Only "(Recommended)" is prose.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Parakeet_Description
data.comment: "NVIDIA Parakeet" and "ONNX" are product names — never translated.
data.value: NVIDIA Parakeet permezz ta' ONNX. Tniżżil ta' ~670 MB. 25 lingwa Ewropea, identifikati awtomatikament. L-aktar magna veloċi — taħdem fuq kwalunkwe CPU, l-ebda GPU meħtieġa. L-ebda traduzzjoni.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Whisper_Name
data.comment: A product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Whisper_Description
data.comment: "Whisper.net" is a library name — never translated.
data.value: Rikonoxximent tad-diskors lokali permezz ta' Whisper.net. Ittestjat sew, ~99 lingwa, għażla tas-sors u traduzzjoni għall-Ingliż.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Gemma4_Name
data.comment: "Gemma 4" is a model family name — never translated. Only "(Experimental)" is prose.

data.name: Settings_Engine_Gemma4_Description
data.comment: "Google Gemma 4 E4B" and "llama.cpp" are product names — never translated.
data.value: Google Gemma 4 E4B permezz ta' llama.cpp. Jeħtieġ tniżżil ta' ~10 GB. Bl-Ingliż biss. Aħjar b'diskors ċar.

data.name: Settings_Engine_OpenAiCompatible_Name
data.comment: "OpenAI" is a product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_Engine_OpenAiCompatible_Description
data.comment: "Cloud providers" must match the wording of Settings_CloudProviders_Title — it names that page.
data.value: Traskrizzjoni bis-sħaba permezz taċ-ċavetta tal-API tiegħek stess ta' OpenAI, Groq, jew waħda kompatibbli. L-awdjo jintbagħat lill-fornitur ikkonfigurat — xejn ma jaħdem lokalment. Veloċi anke fuq hardware dgħajjef. Fakultattiv; ikkonfigura ċ-ċavetta tiegħek taħt Fornituri tas-Sħaba hawn taħt.

data.name: Settings_Engine_XaiGrok_Name
data.comment: "xAI Grok" is a product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_Engine_XaiGrok_Description
data.comment: "Cloud providers" must match the wording of Settings_CloudProviders_Title — it names that page.
data.value: xAI Grok Speech-to-Text permezz taċ-ċavetta tal-API tiegħek stess ta' xAI. L-awdjo jintbagħat lil xAI — xejn ma jaħdem lokalment. Veloċi anke fuq hardware dgħajjef. Fakultattiv; ikkonfigura ċ-ċavetta tiegħek taħt Fornituri tas-Sħaba hawn taħt.

data.name: Settings_WhisperModel_Heading
data.comment: Page heading. The navigation label is Settings_WhisperModel_Title.

data.name: Settings_WhisperModel_Description
data.value: Mudelli akbar huma aktar preċiżi iżda jużaw aktar disk u CPU/GPU.

data.name: Settings_WhisperModel_NoTranslationTooltip
data.value: Traskrizzjoni biss — it-traduzzjoni għall-Ingliż teħtieġ mudell multilingwi

data.name: Settings_WhisperModel_NoTranslationBadge
data.comment: Small badge beside a model that cannot translate. Keep it short.

data.name: Settings_WhisperModel_NotDownloaded
data.comment: Keep the parentheses — it sits beside the model name.

data.name: Settings_WhisperOutput_Description
data.comment: "Whisper" is a product name — never translated.
data.value: Għażliet li jsawru l-output speċifiċi għall-magna Whisper.

data.name: Settings_WhisperOutput_PunctuationNote
data.value: Meta mqabbad, it-traskrizzjoni tinkludi virgoli, punti, u punteġġjatura oħra.

data.name: Settings_WhisperOutput_ProfanityOn
data.comment: The four asterisks are the literal masking Whisper applies — keep them.

data.name: Settings_WhisperOutput_ProfanityNote
data.value: Meta mqabbad, kliem oxxen rikonoxxut jinbidel b'asteriski.

data.name: Settings_Gemma4Model_Description
data.comment: "Gemma 4", "llama.cpp", "E4B", "E2B" and "mmproj" are identifiers — never translated.
data.value: Agħżel varjant ta' Gemma 4 għall-magna llama.cpp. E4B hija aktar preċiża; E2B hija aktar veloċi (inqas parametri attivi). Kull tniżżil jinkludi projettur viżiv (mmproj).

data.name: Settings_ParakeetModel_Description
data.comment: "NVIDIA Parakeet", "INT8" and "fp32" are identifiers — never translated.
data.value: NVIDIA Parakeet taħdem kompletament fuq is-CPU — l-ebda GPU meħtieġa. Tagħmel it-traskrizzjoni ta' 25 lingwa Ewropea (identifikati awtomatikament) b'punteġġjatura u ittri kapitali. INT8 hija l-prestabbilita rakkomandata: żgħira u veloċi. Il-preċiżjoni sħiħa (fp32) hija ftit aktar preċiża iżda 4× akbar u aktar bil-mod biex tiddikodifika.

data.name: Settings_CloudProviders_OpenAi_Name
data.comment: "OpenAI" is a product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_CloudProviders_OpenAi_Description
data.value: Taħdem ma' OpenAI, Groq, jew kwalunkwe host ieħor li jimplimenta l-API tat-traskrizzjoni ta' OpenAI.

data.name: Settings_CloudProviders_Xai_Name
data.comment: A product name — never translated.

data.name: Settings_CloudProviders_KeySavedBadge
data.comment: Keep the leading check mark.

data.name: Settings_Prompts_Description
data.comment: "Gemma 4" is a model family name — never translated.
data.value: L-istruzzjoni mibgħuta lill-magna Gemma 4 ma' kull traskrizzjoni. Il-prompt attiv huwa mmarkat bil-planċier tal-aċċent.

data.name: Settings_Prompts_Help_SpeechLangDescription
data.comment: Follows the literal token {speech_lang}, which is rendered separately in bold. Keep the leading dash.
data.value: — il-lingwa mitkellma, meħuda mill-paġna tas-settings tal-Lingwi. B'“Awto-identifika” tidher bħala “il-lingwa identifikata”.

data.name: Settings_Prompts_Help_TextLangDescription
data.comment: Follows the literal token {text_lang}, which is rendered separately in bold. Keep the leading dash.
data.value: — il-lingwa tal-output. Tvarja mil-lingwa mitkellma biss meta t-traduzzjoni tkun attiva; inkella tidher bħala l-istess lingwa mitkellma.

data.name: Settings_Prompts_Help_TranslationBody
